ValidationRule.description: Opportunity should be restricted from marking as Sold until the Agency is marked as Completed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( StageName ), Assisted_by_Agent__c = true, TEXT(StageName) = 'Sold', TEXT(Agency__r.Status__c) <> 'Completed' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Agency registration should be Completed before closing the deal
